description: Election Commission - Notice declaring S. Naguleswaran as a member of Puttalam Urban Council.
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Puttalam Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
